Static PWA Shell & Service Worker Boot Architecture

nodes.label: Pase Taquero & Plan Destacado (Free vs Premium Business Model)
nodes.norm_label: pase taquero & plan destacado (free vs premium business model)
nodes.rationale: Dual-sided freemium model: consumers can upgrade to Pase Taquero ($39 MXN/mo) for Taco de Oro card, coupons, and neighborhood routes; businesses can upgrade to Plan Destacado ($249 MXN/mo) for 8-stamp loyalty, cross-filtered analytics, and ROI calculator vs delivery apps.

nodes.label: Volatile Unregistered Guest Profile & 1.5s Simulated Checkout
nodes.norm_label: volatile unregistered guest profile & 1.5s simulated checkout
nodes.rationale: Keeps profile edits in volatile session memory so page reloads reset to clean 'Usuario Invitado' state before live pitch demos, and simulates a 1.5s secure payment flow with confetti to unlock Pase Taquero.

nodes.label: Manual PWA Configuration & Offline Cache Strategy
nodes.norm_label: manual pwa configuration & offline cache strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses manifest.json with theme colors (#fbf4e8 and #140c07) and a native Service Worker (sw.js) registered in app.js for installability and offline caching.

nodes.label: Inverted Light Map Style & 'Lugares para Descubrir' Carousel
nodes.norm_label: inverted light map style & 'lugares para descubrir' carousel
nodes.rationale: Inverts map aesthetics from dark to warm light (#F4EADC/#EFE1D1) with high-contrast dark streets (#2F251E) to improve outdoor sunlight legibility, paired with a horizontal scroll-snap carousel and <50ms reactive DOM updates without full tree re-renders.

nodes.label: Semantic Culinary SVG Map Markers
nodes.rationale: Replaces generic rotated map pins with inline semantic SVGs (taco, birria pot/goat, fish, torta/cutlery, cake slice) so users identify food categories without reading labels.

nodes.label: design.md: Phase 4 UI/UX Refinement & Business Logic Roadmap
nodes.norm_label: design.md: phase 4 ui/ux refinement & business logic roadmap
nodes.rationale: Centralizes functional, UI/UX, and architectural specifications for Phase 4 MVP refinement focused on mobile-first ergonomics, tactile navigation, and pitch readiness.

nodes.label: 3D Collectible Lightbox, Album Sorting & Web Share Flow
nodes.norm_label: 3d collectible lightbox, album sorting & web share flow
nodes.rationale: Prevents 3D card clipping on compact viewports (375px-390px) using width: min(300px, 82vw) and aspect-ratio: 5/7 with perspective: 1200px, adds in-memory sorting (rarity, number, name, status), rich Web Share API template, and single-use coupon redemption codes.

nodes.label: Sequential 1-8 Loyalty Visits & Passive Counter Validation UX
nodes.norm_label: sequential 1-8 loyalty visits & passive counter validation ux
nodes.rationale: Replaces developer-facing instructions on the consumer screen with an immersive passive counter mode ('Muestra esta pantalla al pagar en caja', 10-min countdown, large code, temporary QR) and sequential 1-to-8 visit state machine.

nodes.label: Design System Tokens (Warm Light Palette, Gold/Teal/Terra Accents)
nodes.norm_label: design system tokens (warm light palette, gold/teal/terra accents)
nodes.rationale: Establishes CSS custom properties (--bg #fbf4e8, --ink #2a1a0e, --gold #dcb45d, --teal #3db6aa, --action #f26a1b, --display Cinzel, --sans Manrope) for editorial gastronomic identity.

nodes.label: Zero-Framework Vanilla ES Modules & Pure CSS3 Architecture
nodes.norm_label: zero-framework vanilla es modules & pure css3 architecture
nodes.rationale: Avoids React, Vite, Webpack, and Tailwind CSS in favor of semantic HTML5, native ES Modules, and organized CSS3 rules in style.css for a lightweight static mobile-first PWA.

nodes.label: AGENT.md: Architectural Spec & Monolithic React Prototype Reference
nodes.norm_label: agent.md: architectural spec & monolithic react prototype reference
nodes.rationale: Defines strict zero-framework, zero-bundler Vanilla ES Modules + pure CSS3 architecture to migrate the reference React App.tsx prototype into a static PWA hosted on Vercel.
